evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Etablere og videreutvikle standarder, governance og beste praksis for rapportering, semantisk modellering og analyse. ('Establish and further develop standards, governance and best practices for reporting, semantic modelling and analysis.')
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasise standards, governance, best practice, and data quality ('Bidra til god kvalitet gjennom datakvalitet, dokumentasjon') with no velocity/speed framing anywhere in the JD, consistent with the audited European tendency toward governance vocabulary.
evidence.domain_risk: hjelper Coop å ta bedre beslutninger hver dag ('helps Coop make better decisions every day')
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect internal retail business decisions (reporting, KPIs) with no regulatory, financial-reporting, or compliance framing anywhere in the JD, placing this at low despite the large retail scale.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Sammen med teamet bidrar du til gode standarder, governance og beste praksis ('Together with the team you contribute to good standards, governance and best practice')
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing Power BI platform, Microsoft Fabric environment, and Data Engineers team already operate at Coop, but the role is explicitly tasked with establishing and further developing standards from a less mature governance baseline, placing this at mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Ha fagansvar for Coops Power BI-plattform, inkludert administrasjon og videreutvikling av Microsoft Fabric, og jobbe med ytelse og kapasitet ('Have subject-matter responsibility for Coop's Power BI platform, including administration and further development of Microsoft Fabric, and work with performance and capacity')
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific platforms and technical concerns (Power BI, Microsoft Fabric administration, performance and capacity, semantic modelling) with precise application context, reading as written by a hiring manager who knows the actual work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Som Analytics Engineer blir du en viktig kobling mellom forretning, analyse og teknologi ('As an Analytics Engineer you become an important link between business, analytics and technology')
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's core focus is the internal Power BI/data platform itself (semantic models, KPIs, governance, self-service enablement for internal users) rather than a specific external-facing function, placing it as internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Ha fagansvar for Coops Power BI-plattform... Etablere og videreutvikle standarder, governance og beste praksis
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns platform subject-matter responsibility and establishes standards (strategic) but also translates business needs into solutions and supports users directly (execution), a genuine mix.
evidence.ai_role: Erfaring med eller interesse for å bruke AI-assisterte utviklingsverktøy som en naturlig del av utviklings- og analysearbeidet ('Experience with or interest in using AI-assisted development tools as a natural part of development and analysis work')
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI tool usage appears only as a soft preferred bonus point ('interest in using') rather than an expected skill, and the phrasing is vague ('interest in') rather than demonstrated proficiency, so this is classified as none per the tie-breaker for vague AI phrases.
evidence.testing_framing: Bidra til god kvalitet gjennom datakvalitet, dokumentasjon og felles prinsipper og arbeidsmetoder ('Contribute to good quality through data quality, documentation and shared principles and working methods')
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is named as an owned responsibility with a contribution verb, though phrased somewhat generally compared to a strict ownership framing.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Etablere og videreutvikle standarder, governance og beste praksis for rapportering, semantisk modellering og analyse
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Governance and quality language recurs throughout responsibilities and requirements but without regulatory or compliance-specific framing, keeping this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Ha fagansvar for Coops Power BI-plattform, inkludert administrasjon og videreutvikling av Microsoft Fabric-miljøet ('Have subject-matter responsibility for Coop's Power BI platform, including administration and further development of the Microsoft Fabric environment')
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role administers and further develops ('videreutvikling') an existing Power BI/Fabric platform rather than building new infrastructure from scratch, a fix/scale mandate.
evidence.language_gate: Gode norsk- eller skandinaviskkunnskaper, og god evne til å kommunisere på engelsk. ('Good Norwegian or Scandinavian language skills, and good ability to communicate in English.')
evidence.work_arrangement: Fleksibel arbeidstid og hybrid arbeidshverdag ('Flexible working hours and hybrid working day'); med mulighet for hjemmekontor inntil to dager i uken ('with the possibility of working from home up to two days a week')
